evidence: Validation-labeled PR modifying src/validation.cpp and introducing background block prefetching during block connection.
rationale: Prefetching blocks asynchronously before connection yields substantial, measured speedups across IBD and reindexing. Author benchmarks show up to a 1.57x speedup for reindex-chainstate on SSD and 1.13x for full IBD, with reviewer confirmation of noticeable improvements during sync benchmarks.
